learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to make big groups of tens and count numbers in a very easy way!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Counting many things one by one takes a long time. So, we make bundles or groups of ten! It makes counting very fast.
If we have 14 sticks, we tie 10 sticks into one big bundle. Now we have 1 bundle of 'Ten' and 4 loose sticks as 'Ones'!
We can keep adding bundles of ten to reach big numbers like 20, 30, and all the way up to 100. It is like climbing a number ladder!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Matchstick Bundles
fun_activity.instructions: Take some crayons or matchsticks. Use a rubber band to tie them into groups of ten. Count how many tens and ones you have!

quick_recap: ⭐ Grouping things into tens makes them super easy to count.
⭐ Numbers are made of bundles (Tens) and loose items (Ones).
⭐ We can build numbers all the way to 100 using tens and ones!
